ExcludedSites.title: Sites never recorded
ExcludedSites.description: Host names, such as bank.example; the sites under each are covered too. Added to each person's own list.

BlurTerms.title: Words always blurred
BlurTerms.description: Organisation-wide words suggested for blurring, such as internal project codes.

SensitiveFieldPatterns.title: Extra sensitive field names
SensitiveFieldPatterns.description: Words in a field's name or label whose value is never read, added to the built-in list.

Locked.title: Settings shown read-only
Locked.description: ScreenshotQuality, IncludeOriginals or AskWhereToSave, locked at their defaults.

DisableKeystrokeRecording.title: Turn off "Record what's typed"
DisableKeystrokeRecording.description: When true, recordings keep clicks and screenshots only: no field values are read.

RecordTypingByDefault.title: Start recordings with "Record what's typed" ticked
RecordTypingByDefault.description: True: it starts ticked (each person can still untick it). False: it starts unticked and can't be changed in Settings. Not set: each person's choice.

Language.title: Language of Steps
Language.description: The language Steps is in: its screens, the words new recordings are written in, and the fixed words in exports. Not set: the browser's language.

LanguageTone.title: Language tone of new recordings
LanguageTone.description: casual (Steps' own short style), plain (everyday words) or formal (full sentences). Not set: casual, each person's choice.

ShowUnnamedTyping.title: Show typing into unnamed boxes
ShowUnnamedTyping.description: Whether a step shows what was typed into something the recording couldn't name. Not set: off, each person's choice.

BlurStrength.title: Blur suggestions
BlurStrength.description: How much Steps looks for to suggest blurring: light (emails, phone, card and bank numbers, always-blur words), standard (also postcodes, details beside their labels and the person's own names) or thorough (also file names and paths). Not set: standard, each person's choice.

DefaultPdfBrand.title: Default brand for exports
DefaultPdfBrand.description: The id of a brand profile.

AppColoursBrand.title: Brand for the app's colours
AppColoursBrand.description: The id of a brand profile.
